original_finding_content.subject: Absence finding — Reddit r/Etsy and r/EtsySellers direct access
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** Searched actively for direct Reddit posts from r/Etsy and r/EtsySellers within the time window. Found no directly accessible Reddit thread content; all Reddit URLs returned access errors on fetch.
**Source:** N/A
**source_type:** N/A
**verification_status:** could_not_verify
**Date:** N/A
**Notes:** Absence finding. 12+ distinct web_search queries targeting site:reddit.com/r/Etsy and site:reddit.com/r/EtsySellers were executed. Multiple Reddit thread URLs were identified via search results and intermediary articles, but Reddit.com consistently returned permissions/access errors on web_fetch. This is an access limitation, not evidence that relevant Reddit content does not exist. Known threads were surfaced via intermediary journalism (ValueAddedResource, EcommerceBytes) but intermediary-sourced findings are classified under could_not_verify per protocol.
